description:
Teagan Hargrove can handle just about anything: excelling in law school, balancing a demanding internship, and planning her best friend’s wedding—all while surviving the crushing expectations of her elite family. The one thing she can’t seem to handle? Bad sex. After breaking up with her sexually inept boyfriend, Teagan is forced to face an entire wedding season painfully single—and the only other single person in her social circle is her childhood friend, Heath Reynolds. To make matters worse, they hate each other…but hate doesn’t cancel out attraction. So when Heath proposes that they use each other to curb their sexual frustration, they strike a deal: a situationship. Pre-scheduled hookups. No strings attached.No commitment. Just a mutually beneficial arrangement to get them through the summer. It’s not supposed to mean anything. Until it does.
Source: Webtoon
